description: Offline demo places for the Explore page. Selection criterion: different surface types, chosen by the project owner from places whose public NISAR GCOV catalog coverage (HH+HV, 1 Jun - 30 Sep 2026) was checked BEFORE any radar window was read. Places were not chosen for expected or striking results.
selection_rule: Largest compatible HH+HV group returned by src.live_engine.group_products for the date range (ties: catalog order); its first max_dates acquisition dates; window_km square centred on the point.
